notes.title: Cat at Home Japanese Version Confirmation!
notes.notes:
Dear Little Master/Mistress,

We are thrilled to officially announce that the Japanese localization has now been added to Cat at Home DEMO. We warmly welcome everyone to come and experience it!

Join forces with the cat to use your wisdom to resolve crises at home and embark on this adventure together.

Additionally, the full version of Cat at Home will fully support Japanese. We understand that there are differences in language habits and culture across regions. If you encounter any issues while playing the Japanese version, please feel free to provide feedback to us through the STEAM community or this announcement.
